 Just Say YESS! Philippine Airlines Brings Back Its Year-End Seat Sale
 Travel & Adventure Trending & Features 
 November 6, 2026 
 WhenInManila 
 The best way to close out the year isn’t just looking back at where you’ve been—it’s giving yourself somewhere exciting to look forward to. Philippine Airlines (PAL) is officially inviting travelers to stop putting their dream getaways on hold with the return of its highly anticipated campaign: Just Say YESS! 
 Whether you have been eyeing a sun-soaked escape across the Philippine islands or an unforgettable international journey, PAL’s Year-End Seat Sale is your sign to turn “Someday, I’ll go” into “Let’s book it!”
 The official sale runs from November 9 to 15, 2026, offering massive discounts across domestic and international routes:
 Domestic and International Flights:  Enjoy up to 40% OFF for travel between December 1, 2026, and March 31, 2027, and up to 60% OFF for travel from April 1, 2027 onwards.
 Asia & Regional Destinations:  Take up to 40% OFF on flights to Japan (HND, NRT, KIX, NGO, FUK, CTS), South Korea (ICN, PUS), ASEAN destinations (SIN, BKK, KUL, CGK, DPS, DAD, SGN, HAN, KTI), and Greater China (HKG, TPE, PEK, PVG, XMN, JJN).
 Long-Haul & Transpacific Travels:  Save up to 35% OFF on flights to Canada (YYZ, YVR) and the USA (LAX, SFO, JFK, HNL, SEA, ORD).
 Australia, Middle East, Guam & Micronesia:  Enjoy up to 40% OFF on flights heading to Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Port Moresby, Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Guam, Saipan, and Koror.
 Travel periods for applicable international offers start December 1, 2026, onwards.
 It’s time to say yes to yourself and embrace your next adventure. Check PAL’ s official channels for complete booking details, eligible routes, and terms and conditions.
 Head over to Philippine Airlines’ official website or app between November 9–15, 2026, to lock in your next trip!
